scripts.dev: pnpm build:web && pnpm db:migrate:local && wrangler dev -c apps/web/wrangler.json -c apps/jobs/wrangler.json --persist-to .wrangler/shared
scripts.bindings: wrangler types -c apps/jobs/wrangler.json apps/jobs/worker-configuration.d.ts && wrangler types -c apps/web/wrangler.json apps/web/worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm bindings && pnpm --filter @demo/web typecheck && tsc -p apps/jobs/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/ai/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB -c apps/jobs/wrangler.json --local --persist-to .wrangler/shared
scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm build:web && node scripts/release.mjs staging deploy
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm build:web && node scripts/release.mjs production deploy
